description: A shell script for detecting and selecting iOS development team IDs based on various preferences and Xcode configurations.

methods.name: detect_python
methods.description: Detects available Python interpreter from a list of candidates.

methods.name: append_team
methods.description: Adds a team ID, free status, and name to internal arrays if not already present.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_preferences
methods.description: Loads team IDs from Xcode preferences plist using Python for JSON parsing.

methods.name: load_teams_from_legacy_defaults_key
methods.description: Loads team IDs from legacy defaults key.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_managed_profiles
methods.description: Loads team IDs from Xcode managed provisioning profiles.

methods.name: has_xcode_account
methods.description: Checks if an Xcode account is configured.
